name: Arctic Fox
description: A small fox native to the Arctic regions, known for its thick, warm fur that also serves as camouflage.

name: Beluga Whale
description: An arctic and sub-arctic cetacean known for its distinctive white color and high-pitched calls.

name: Caribou
description: A species of deer native to arctic and subarctic regions, known for undertaking long seasonal journeys.

name: Lemming
description: A small rodent, usually living in or near the Arctic in tundra biomes.

name: Musk Ox
description: An Arctic-dwelling, shaggy-coated mammal known for its strong odor and defensive circling behavior.

name: Narwhal
description: A medium-sized toothed whale that possesses a large, characteristic tusk from a protruding canine tooth.

name: Penguin
description: A group of aquatic flightless birds living almost exclusively in the Southern Hemisphere.

name: Polar Bear
description: A hypercarnivorous bear whose native range lies largely within the Arctic Circle.

name: Snowy Owl
description: A large, white owl of the true owl family, native to Arctic regions of North America and Eurasia.

name: Walrus
description: A large flippered marine mammal with a discontinuous distribution about the North Pole in the Arctic Ocean.

name: Addax
description: A critically endangered antelope that lives in the Sahara, known for its long, twisted horns.

name: Camel
description: An even-toed ungulate known for its distinctive fatty deposits known as humps on its back.

name: Fennec Fox
description: A small crepuscular fox native to the Sahara Desert, recognizable by its unusually large ears.

name: Gila Monster
description: A species of venomous lizard native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico.

name: Jerboa
description: A hopping desert rodent of Asia and northern Africa, known for its long hind legs.

name: Kangaroo Rat
description: A small rodent of North American deserts, able to generate water through metabolic processes.

name: Meerkat
description: A small mongoose found in southern Africa, known for its upright posture and cooperative behavior.

name: Rattlesnake
description: A group of venomous snakes, best known for the characteristic rattle at the tip of the tail.

name: Roadrunner
description: A fast-running ground cuckoo native to North and Central America, found in arid country.

name: Scorpion
description: A predatory arachnid of the order Scorpiones, having a segmented tail tipped with a venomous stinger.

name: Thorny Devil
description: An Australian lizard covered in conical spines, which are mostly uncalcified keratin.

name: Tortoise
description: A land-dwelling reptile of the order Testudines, known for its bony or cartilaginous shell.

name: Armadillo
description: A New World placental mammal with a leathery armor covering.

name: Clam
description: A common name for several kinds of bivalve molluscs.

name: Cone Snail
description: A predatory sea snail that uses a venomous harpoon-like tooth to capture prey.

name: Crab
description: A decapod crustacean with a very short projecting tail, usually hidden entirely under the thorax.

name: Hermit Crab
description: A type of crab that has a soft abdomen and protects it by living inside an empty gastropod shell.

name: Leatherback Sea Turtle
description: The largest of all living turtles, known for its lack of a bony shell and long-distance ocean journeys.

name: Limpet
description: An aquatic snail with a shell that is broadly conical in shape.

name: Lobster
description: A family of large marine crustaceans with long bodies and muscular tails.

name: Nautilus
description: A pelagic marine mollusc of the cephalopod family Nautilidae, known for its chambered pearly shell.

name: Oyster
description: A common name for a number of different families of salt-water bivalve molluscs.

name: Scallop
description: A marine bivalve mollusc with a fan-shaped shell that is often fluted.

name: Snail
description: A shelled gastropod, characterized by its helical, spiral shell.

name: Black Widow
description: A species of spider notorious for the female's neurotoxic venom.

name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
description: A group of four highly venomous species of octopus that are found in tide pools and coral reefs.

name: Box Jellyfish
description: A cnidarian invertebrate distinguished by its cube-shaped medusa, with some species producing extremely potent venom.

name: Cobra
description: A venomous snake of a genus occurring in Africa and Asia, noted for its ability to expand the skin of its neck into a hood.

name: Funnel-Web Spider
description: A spider native to eastern Australia, known for its highly toxic and fast-acting venom.

name: Platypus
description: A semiaquatic, egg-laying mammal endemic to eastern Australia, where the male has a venomous spur on the hind foot.

name: Stonefish
description: A genus of venomous, marine fish, the members of which are known for their potent neurotoxins.

name: Taipan
description: A genus of large, fast-moving, and highly venomous snakes found in Australasia.

name: Baboon
description: A primate comprising the genus Papio, one of the 23 genera of Old World monkeys, that lives in large troops.

name: Bonobo
description: An endangered great ape and one of the two species making up the genus Pan, known for its matriarchal and peaceful society.

name: Capybara
description: The largest living rodent in the world, native to South America and known for its gregarious nature.

name: Chimpanzee
description: A species of great ape native to the forest and savannah of tropical Africa, living in complex communities.

name: Dolphin
description: An aquatic mammal within the infraorder Cetacea, known for its intelligence and living in social groups called pods.

name: Elephant
description: A large mammal of the family Elephantidae, known for living in complex, matriarchal family groups.

name: Howler Monkey
description: A genus of New World monkeys, famous for their loud vocalizations and living in groups.

name: Humpback Whale
description: A species of baleen whale known for its long migrations and complex songs, often traveling in loose groups.

name: Hyena
description: A feliform carnivoran mammal known for its complex social behavior and living in large groups called clans.

name: Lion
description: A large cat of the genus Panthera, which has a muscular, deep-chested body and lives in groups called prides.

name: Orca
description: A toothed whale belonging to the oceanic dolphin family, which lives in tight-knit, matrilineal family groups.

name: Prairie Dog
description: A herbivorous burrowing rodent native to the grasslands of North America, living in large colonies or towns.

name: Wildebeest
description: An antelope in the genus Connochaetes, known for forming large herds that graze in seasonal patterns.

name: Wolf
description: A large canine native to Eurasia and North America, known for living and hunting in family units called packs.

name: Arctic Tern
description: A seabird of the tern family, known for undertaking the longest regular migration of any known animal.

name: Canada Goose
description: A large wild goose with a black head and neck, white cheeks, and a brown body, known for its V-formation flight.

name: Gray Whale
description: A baleen whale that travels between feeding and breeding grounds along the North American coast.

name: Monarch Butterfly
description: A milkweed butterfly known for its seasonal journey of up to 3,000 miles from Canada to Mexico.

name: Salmon
description: A ray-finned fish famous for being born in fresh water, migrating to the ocean, then returning to fresh water to reproduce.

name: Sandpiper
description: A large family of waders or shorebirds, many of which undertake long-distance annual journeys.

name: Sockeye Salmon
description: A species of salmon in the Northern Pacific Ocean, known for its epic upstream journey to spawn.

name: Swallow
description: A passerine bird found on all continents except Antarctica, adapted to aerial feeding and known for long-distance travel.

name: Aardvark
description: A medium-sized, burrowing, nocturnal mammal native to Africa, which feeds on ants and termites.

name: Badger
description: A carnivorous mammal in the family Mustelidae, known for its powerful claws and tendency to hunt at night.

name: Bat
description: A mammal whose forelimbs form webbed wings, making them the only mammals naturally capable of true and sustained flight.

name: Civet
description: A slender, nocturnal carnivorous mammal native to tropical Asia and Africa.

name: Fox
description: A small to medium-sized, omnivorous mammal belonging to several genera of the family Canidae, often active at night.

name: Jaguar
description: A large cat species and the only living member of the genus Panthera native to the Americas, often hunting at night.

name: Leopard
description: A large cat of the genus Panthera, known for its spotted coat and its ability as a solitary, opportunistic hunter.

name: Owl
description: An order of birds of prey, most of which are solitary and hunt for small mammals, insects, and other birds at night.

name: Raccoon
description: A medium-sized mammal native to North America, recognizable by its facial mask and ringed tail.

name: Tarsier
description: A haplorrhine primate with enormous eyes, whose diet consists mainly of insects which it catches by leaping.

name: Macaw
description: A long-tailed, often colorful New World parrot.

name: Okapi
description: An artiodactyl mammal native to the northeast of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, closely related to the giraffe.

name: Orangutan
description: A great ape native to the rainforests of Borneo and Sumatra, known for its long arms and reddish-brown hair.

name: Piranha
description: A member of a family of omnivorous freshwater fish that live in South American rivers, especially the Amazon.

name: Poison Dart Frog
description: A common name of a group of frogs in the family Dendrobatidae which are native to tropical Central and South America.

name: Sloth
description: A medium-sized mammal known for its slow movement, spending most of its life hanging upside down in tropical trees.

name: Toucan
description: A brightly marked bird with a large, often colorful bill, native to the Neotropics.
